description: This file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state and user data in a Flutter application. It handles login, logout, token management, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages authentication state, including token, user info, and loading status, providing methods for login and logout.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the authentication state by retrieving stored token and user info.

methods.name: _safeMe
methods.description: Attempts to fetch the current user info, returning null if an error occurs.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, updates token and user info on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication state and notifies listeners.
